papers.title: Camp letter
lines: Dear Alice, we are cutting peat for the winter. The wind has taken my hat to Chile.
The sheep are shorn, the shearing shed is warm and the smoko is the best part of the day.

trail.clue: A shepherd hid a tobacco tin of coins near the big rock, 'where the wind can't read'.

papers.title: Visitor's postcard
lines: Gentoo and Magellanic and rockhopper, all in one place and all in a hurry.
One came and sat on my foot for an hour. I think he was waiting for a bus.

papers.title: Cathedral card
lines: The cathedral in Stanley has an arch of whale jawbones outside. They have stood for nearly a century.
The vicar says they remind him to be humble. The sheep say nothing.

papers.title: Smoko note
lines: Smoko at ten: tea, scones, and gossip about the other farm.
The other farm is thirty miles away, and the gossip takes three days to arrive.
